image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a marine mollusk, specifically a chiton, clinging to a rocky surface. The organism features an elongated, oval body covered by eight distinct, overlapping calcareous plates (valves) running down the center. These plates are surrounded by a thick, leathery girdle densely covered in coarse, hair-like spines (setae). The coloration is a mix of earthy browns, greys, and tans with mottled patterns on the plates.
